seoTitle: Contact — Book a Free AI Chatbot Demo
seoDescription: Contact DialogHive to book a free demo of an AI chatbot for your business — WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and website. We reply within one business day.
formIntro: Fill in the form and our team will get back to you within one business day with a demo slot and a tailored recommendation.

faqs.q: How fast will you reply to my message?
faqs.a: We reply to every inquiry within one business day — usually much faster. Demo requests are prioritized.

faqs.q: What happens in the free demo?
faqs.a: We show you a live AI chatbot configured for your industry, walk through the client portal, discuss your channels and volumes, and answer all questions. No commitment, no credit card.

faqs.q: What information should I include in my message?
faqs.a: Your business type, which channels you want (WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, website), and roughly how many customer messages you get per day. That lets us prepare a relevant demo and accurate quote.

faqs.q: Do you offer support after launch?
faqs.a: Yes — every plan includes support, and Growth and Scale plans include priority support. See the Pricing page for details.
